task_description: Predict whether a comment is in favor of or against a given topic. Neutral comments are excluded so the task is binary.

post.description: Original comment text from the VAST dataset.

topic.description: Topic the comment is judged against, preferring the crowdsourced topic.

label.description: FAVOR is the positive class (VAST label 1, pro). AGAINST is the negative class (VAST label 0, con).
